purpose: Three visible classroom steps: load model, obtain vectors, compare security. Preparation does not load an embedding model. No classroom PCA.
environment: Existing r-reticulate environment; CPU; cached glove.gensim and companion vectors; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1. No installation or download.
serialization_note: Cross-route CSV differences are floating-point text precision at about 5e-15; each route independently matches the earlier example vectors within tolerance.
original_outputs: example-output/word-vectors.csv and example-output/security-vectors.csv; earlier Flair 0.15.1 record retained unchanged.
